about: splat-effects golden vectors (effect graph v1). Regenerate: cargo run -p splat-effects --bin splat-effects-golden -- --write. rest.rot and fast_rot are w,x,y,z unit quaternions; scale/fast_scale linear; alpha linear; cov = exact-mode Σ' as xx xy xz yy yz zz; dc = SH DC coefficient (base colour 0.5 + 0.2820948·dc). Hash floats are (h >> 8)·2^-24. SH view direction: unchanged.
